articleHtml:
Nifty Fifty’s is built around the kind of meal where the extras can matter almost as much as the main item.

You might start with a freshly ground cheeseburger, add fresh-cut fries, order an onion ring or cheese topping, and finish with one of the restaurant’s hand-spun milkshakes. Another visit might mean a Philly cheesesteak, chicken sandwich, hot dog, breakfast platter, or a loaded order of smothered fries.

Use the Nifty Fifty’s Nutrition Calculator above to compare available calorie information and combine the individual foods you actually order.

Think About the Whole Diner Order

At Nifty Fifty’s, looking at the burger alone may tell only part of the story.

A typical order can include:

Burger or sandwich

Fresh-cut fries or onion rings

Cheese, bacon, chili, or other add-ons

Milkshake, malt, soda, or another fountain drink

The meal total can therefore be very different from the calorie value of the entrée.

For the most useful estimate, build the order one item at a time instead of stopping after the burger.

Single and Double Burgers Need Separate Records

Nifty Fifty’s current burger menu is built around freshly ground, hand-pattied 100% beef.

Several burgers can be ordered in different patty configurations, which makes serving size one of the first things to check.

For example, the current NutritionSolver database lists approximately:

Burger

Calories

Hamburger, Single

550

Cheeseburger, Single

650

Cheeseburger, Double

950

Bacon Cheeseburger, Double

1,080

These numbers show why “Nifty Fifty’s burger calories” is too broad a question.

The number of patties, cheese, bacon, sauce, and other toppings can create a major difference.

Always select the exact burger version.

Texas Ringer Is More Than a Cheeseburger

The Texas Ringer is one of Nifty Fifty’s signature burgers.

The current menu builds it with:

Beef patty

Cheese

Bacon

Onion ring

Lettuce

Texas Petal Sauce

That means it should not be estimated from a plain Cheeseburger alone.

NutritionSolver currently lists the Texas Ringer at approximately 890 calories .

If you remove bacon, sauce, or the onion ring, the finished burger may differ from the listed standard recipe.

Royal Burger Has Its Own Onion Ring Addition

The Royal Burger is another Nifty Fifty’s-specific build.

It starts with a cheeseburger and is crowned with a homemade onion ring.

The current NutritionSolver record contains approximately 720 calories .

Because the onion ring is part of the standard recipe, do not add another onion ring serving unless you actually order extra.

Burger Toppings Should Be Treated as Real Customizations

The current official menu lets diners add ingredients such as:

Bacon

Extra cheese

Chili

Onion ring

Fresh grilled mushrooms

Sweet or hot peppers

Free topping choices can also include fried or raw onion, mayo, lettuce, tomato, pickles, and relish.

Some additions contribute very little energy while others can add a meaningful amount.

A useful Nifty Fifty’s calculator should eventually let users start with the base burger and apply the customizations they actually choose.

A Lettuce-Based Burger Is a Different Order

The current menu allows burger buns to be replaced with a bed of lettuce.

That changes the serving because the bread is removed while the beef and chosen toppings remain.

If verified ingredient nutrition becomes available, NutritionSolver should calculate this as a distinct customized burger rather than labeling it as identical to the standard sandwich.

It is also important not to turn a bun substitution into a broad allergen-safety claim. Preparation and cross-contact need separate consideration.

Cheesesteaks Are a Major Part of the Menu

Nifty Fifty’s is a Philadelphia-area diner, and its current menu has a dedicated Philly Steaks section.

Options include:

Cheesesteak

Mushroom Swiss Cheesesteak

Bacon Cheddar Cheesesteak

Chicken Cheesesteak

Buffalo Chicken Cheesesteak

Mushroom Swiss Chicken Cheesesteak

Chicken Caesar Steak

These are full sandwiches served around steak or chicken, cheese, bread, and recipe-specific toppings.

They should remain separate from burgers.

Cheese Choice Can Change a Cheesesteak

The current menu offers several cheese choices for Philly steaks, including options such as:

American

Swiss

Provolone

Pepper Jack

Cheddar

Whiz

A plain Cheesesteak therefore can still vary depending on the cheese and additional toppings selected.

Where verified cheese-component nutrition is available, the calculator should allow the cheese to be changed rather than assigning every Cheesesteak exactly the same finished value.

Chicken Cheesesteak and Beef Cheesesteak Should Not Share Nutrition

NutritionSolver currently lists approximately:

Cheesesteak: 950 calories

Chicken Cheesesteak: 820 calories

The two sandwiches use different proteins.

Additional preparations such as Buffalo Chicken Cheesesteak or Bacon Cheddar Cheesesteak change the recipe again through cheese, bacon, dressing, sauce, or other ingredients.

Choose the named sandwich rather than estimating all Philly steaks from one generic record.

Fresh-Cut Fries Are One of Nifty Fifty’s Signature Sides

Nifty Fifty’s emphasizes that its fries are cut fresh rather than served as a generic frozen fry product.

The current NutritionSolver database lists approximately:

Fresh Cut Fries, Small: 420 calories

Fresh Cut Fries, Large: 780 calories

That makes serving size important.

If two people share one Large fries, the full 780-calorie serving should not automatically be assigned to each person.

Calculate the portion you actually eat.

Spicy Fries Are a Separate Preparation

Current NutritionSolver values include:

Spicy Fries, Small: about 430 calories

Spicy Fries, Large: about 800 calories.

The calorie difference from plain fries may appear modest in the existing data, but the spicy seasoning can also change sodium.

Because the current database does not have reliable sodium information, do not treat 0mg sodium as evidence that either fry preparation is sodium-free.

Cheese Fries Need the Cheese Counted

Cheese Fries combine the fresh-cut fry base with cheese sauce.

The current NutritionSolver Small Cheese Fries record is approximately 580 calories .

That should remain separate from plain fries.

If the customer adds more toppings, calculate the complete loaded version rather than continuing to use the plain Cheese Fries value.

Smothered Fries Are Full Loaded Dishes

The current 2026 menu offers several Smothered Fries, including preparations topped with combinations such as:

Honey BBQ chicken

Bacon and ranch

Philly cheesesteak

Buffalo chicken

Chili and cheese

These can function more like shareable entrées than simple sides.

A strong calculator should treat each current Smothered Fries recipe as its own complete menu item.

If the order is shared, the user should be able to calculate a portion rather than the full tray.

Onion Rings Need the Dipping Sauce Considered

Nifty Fifty’s makes onion rings from fresh sweet onions and serves them with Texas Petal Sauce.

This creates two nutrition components:

Onion rings

and:

Dipping sauce

If the restaurant publishes the sauce separately, NutritionSolver should make it possible to calculate the amount actually consumed.

Do not automatically add an extra sauce when it is already included in a complete published onion-ring serving.

Chicken Has More Than One Menu Format

The current menu goes well beyond one chicken sandwich.

Nifty Fifty’s serves:

Chicken fingers

Chicken nuggets

Golden Fried Chicken Cutlet

Buffalo Chicken Cutlet

Honey Grilled Chicken

Honey Grilled Chicken Texas Ringer

Honey Grilled Mushroom Swiss Chicken

and chicken-based cheesesteaks.

These need their own current records because hand-breaded, grilled, cheese-topped, Buffalo-style, and bacon/onion-ring preparations do not have the same nutrition.

Nugget and Finger Count Should Be Visible

Chicken nuggets and fingers are sold in different quantities.

A nutrition calculator should therefore say:

Chicken Nuggets, 6 Piece

rather than simply:

Chicken Nuggets

The same applies to chicken fingers.

Sauces such as Buffalo, Honey BBQ, Spicy Thai Chili, Garlic Parm, Cheese, or Spicy Cheese can further change the completed order.

Piece count and sauce should be separate calculator decisions.

Filet Mignon Sandwiches Are a Distinct Nifty Fifty’s Category

One feature that differentiates Nifty Fifty’s from many burger chains is its Filet Mignon sandwich menu.

Current versions include:

Filet Mignon Sandwich

Filet Mignon Special

Mushroom Swiss Filet Mignon

Royal Filet Mignon

These are not Philly cheesesteaks.

They use filet as the central protein and have their own cheese, bacon, mushroom, onion-ring, and vegetable combinations.

NutritionSolver should give them a separate category rather than hiding them under generic sandwiches.

Hot Dogs Have Their Own Topping Logic

The current menu also includes old-fashioned boardwalk-style hot dogs.

Available variations include preparations with:

Cheese

Chili

Sauerkraut

and the Coney Island Chili Cheese Dog .

The Texas Tommy uses bacon as part of the preparation.

These should be calculated as their own recipes rather than from hamburger data.

Milkshakes Are a Major Part of the Meal, Not a Small Beverage

Nifty Fifty’s is especially known for its milkshakes and large soda-fountain selection.

Current NutritionSolver examples include approximately:

Vanilla: 680 calories

Chocolate: 720 calories

Strawberry: 690 calories

Black & White: 700 calories

Coffee: 650 calories

Mocha: 710 calories.

A milkshake can therefore contribute as much energy as, or more than, some entrées.

If you drink a shake with a burger and fries, include all three in your meal total.

Exotic Shakes Need Their Own Values

Nifty Fifty’s goes far beyond basic vanilla, chocolate, and strawberry.

The current menu contains numerous specialty shake categories, including cheesecake, cake-and-pie, cookie, candy-bar, and other exotic flavors.

NutritionSolver currently lists examples such as:

Cheesecake: about 900 calories

Oreo Cheesecake: about 980 calories

Dirt Cake: about 1,050 calories

Peanut Butter Kandykake: about 1,100 calories

Death by Chocolate: about 960 calories.

These should remain separate from Blue Ribbon shakes because the mix-ins change the finished serving considerably.

Shake of the Month Should Be Treated as Dynamic

Nifty Fifty’s regularly promotes a featured Shake of the Month.

That means the current flavor can change while the URL and restaurant page remain the same.

NutritionSolver should not permanently treat one monthly shake as the current product.

Use:

Current Shake of the Month

with a last-reviewed date, then move the previous flavor to:

Historical / Seasonal Shakes

when the promotion changes.

Breakfast Availability Depends on Location

Breakfast is not served universally across every Nifty Fifty’s location.

Some current locations explicitly advertise breakfast, while others open later and do not show the same breakfast availability.

Where offered, the breakfast menu includes foods such as:

Three-egg omelets

Breakfast platters

Pancakes

Chicken and waffles

Breakfast sandwiches

Filet Mignon breakfast plates

and other diner-style breakfast choices.

NutritionSolver should label this category:

Breakfast, Select Locations

rather than implying that every store serves every breakfast item.

Breakfast Platters Include More Than the Named Protein

A breakfast platter can include eggs, hash browns, toast, coffee, and meat or another main component depending on the recipe.

That means a Filet Mignon Platter should not be represented by the filet alone.

The serving definition must state what is included.

Similarly, an omelet served with hash browns and toast needs the complete plate nutrition or clearly separated components.

Salads and Chili Should Not Be Missing From a Complete Current Menu

Current Nifty Fifty’s offerings also include salads and homemade chili.

The current menu includes choices such as:

Nifty Caesar Salad

Spicy Chicken Ranch Salad

with optional grilled chicken and other add-ons.

These deserve dedicated searchable records.

Dressings, fried chicken, bacon, cheese, and other extras can change the nutrition considerably, so a salad should not automatically be treated as a low-calorie side.

Nifty Fifty’s Nutrition Questions

How many calories are in a Nifty Fifty’s hamburger?+
How many calories are in a Nifty Fifty’s cheeseburger?+
How many calories are in a Texas Ringer?+
How many calories are in Nifty Fifty’s fries?+
How many calories are in a Nifty Fifty’s milkshake?+
Does Nifty Fifty’s serve breakfast?+
Does Nifty Fifty’s have cheesesteaks?+

Build the Diner Meal You Actually Order

Start with the exact burger, cheesesteak, chicken item, filet sandwich, hot dog, salad, or breakfast entrée .

Then select the correct Single or Double size, piece count, toppings, cheese, or sauce where applicable.

Add the exact Fresh Cut Fries, Cheese Fries, Smothered Fries, onion rings, chili, or other side you eat.

Finally, include your milkshake, malt, soda, dessert-style shake, or other beverage .

At Nifty Fifty’s, a complete meal can contain several substantial components, so calculating them individually gives a much more useful estimate than looking only at the entrée.
